quarterly_data.signal: Volumes (annual report): 2025 sales volume 3,950,397.00 pieces (+20.35%), output 3,542,659.80 pieces (+6.21%), year-end inventory 1,508,233.00 pieces (-21.28%). The company produces mainly to order, stocking some standardised high-volume products against demand, sales plans and capacity.

Optical communications (annual report): in 2025 the company's optical-communications business focused on WSS (wavelength selective switch) core devices, supplying diffraction gratings and supporting optics; it says AI-driven data-center interconnect demand is a key growth direction for WSS. It has built reflective and transmission grating lines (holographic, projection lithography, ion-beam etching and grating replication) and keeps adding diffraction-grating R&D and capacity investment. The company says its prism gratings for WSS modules in high-speed optical networks are in volume production, with performance it describes as at international advanced level, and have entered the supply chains of several leading domestic and overseas optical module companies (not named). It also reports breakthroughs in Faraday rotator crystal growth and processing technology.

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D spending RMB 106,239,759.83, up 8.92%, 9.18% of revenue (11.14% in 2024), none capitalised; R&D staff 319 (14.27% of employees). Projects listed include AI-driven automatic growth of functional crystals (partly completed, for workshop use to raise yield and cut labour cost), CLBO crystals for high-power lasers, low-absorption magneto-optic transparent ceramics and magneto-optical isolators (research completed), high-precision diffractive optical elements and large gratings for high-precision measurement equipment (partly completed).

quarterly_data.signal: Subsidiaries (annual report, 2025): Zhiqi Photonics (ultra-precision optical components) revenue RMB 16,727.01 ten-thousand, up 119.81%, net profit RMB 4,005.86 ten-thousand; Ruichuang Optoelectronics (diffractive and micro-optics) revenue RMB 4,157.52 ten-thousand, up 66.35%, net profit RMB 1,515.81 ten-thousand, up 154.74%; Qingdao Haitai Optoelectronics (optical and nonlinear optical crystal materials) revenue RMB 15,411.12 ten-thousand, net profit RMB 4,736.85 ten-thousand.

2026 business plan (annual report; the company states it is not a performance commitment): in lasers, beyond stabilising industrial nanosecond-UV and fiber-laser business, focus on ultrafast (including disk lasers), deep-UV, ultra-high-power and frontier-science applications; in optical communications, deepen cooperation with key leading customers, expand complex optically-contacted optical assemblies and crystal business, work with customers on R&D and mass production of the next-generation diffraction grating, and seek cooperation with other optical-device makers at home and abroad; push overseas sales of acousto-optic and electro-optic devices; advance the Phase II Building D project toward topping out on schedule and adjust capacity layout to orders on hand. Funding mainly from own funds or bank loans.
